name: Procedural Parity Obfuscation
description: Replaced the semantic "total equals unique" condition (which models easily map to "no duplicates" and thus Independent Set) with an algebraically equivalent but semantically unrelated parity condition: "sum of values equals count of odd values". Since the values are constrained to {0, 1, 2}, this still uniquely forces all values to be <= 1, but models are much less likely to recognize this as a graph property, leading them to write naive parity-tracking backtracking algorithms that will TLE.
